ev_0004.summary: Parallelogram ABCD (A bottom-left, B bottom-right, C top-right, D top-left) with solid edges AB, BC, CD, DA. E lies on the left side DA (A, E, D collinear; E at (106.0,181.2) is on line D-A within about 0.1 px). F and N lie on bottom edge AB. Solid segments: E-F, E-G, G-B (E-G-B is a polyline with a measured kink of about 7 degrees at G, so it is not straightened), plus CV-detected solid segment C-G (seg_01), which is not in the supervisor list and is flagged as a candidate. Dashed straight segments: E-C (through intersection X), D-B (through X), E-N, G-N. X at (222.5,135.2) is the intersection of dashed E-C and dashed D-B. circle_01 is rejected as spurious: its visible arcs are not supported by any circle-consistent figure element, and the dashed chains are straight. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are reported.

payload.notes: Used STYLE METRICS: s=0.0181 cm/px (longest side ~8 cm), line width 1.4pt with round joins, label font 14.5/17.4pt. E--G--B is drawn as a polyline to keep the 7.98° shallow bend at G that the CV evidence supports. No arcs, no C--G, no right-angle marks (none verified). Labels placed per instruction; F and N below, G above-right.
